The warehouse stock list now leaves out products with zero quantity. The full offline suite passes (607 tests, 0 failures).

The change is one `WHERE` condition in `findStockLevelsByWarehouse`, in `src/main/java/com/acme/backoffice/DataStore.java`. It now reads `s.quantity > 0`, and I updated its doc comment to match. I also updated the one-line doc comment on `StockService.getWarehouseStock` (`StockService.java`) to say "products with stock" instead of "products stocked".

`findStockQuantity` is untouched, so asking for the nuts in WH-1 still returns 0. The only other callers of the list are the existing `StockOverviewTest` and the demo, and neither depended on zero rows. Nothing is committed.
